what_changed: Gold jumped 2.8% in a day to a two-month high (NEM +7.9%, AEM +11%) as yields and the dollar fell. Health care surged (MRK +12.6%, LLY +4.5%, sector at a high). Chips weakened (AVGO -12.9% in 5 days). WTI 85.8 (+3% in 5 days); VIX 14.9.

oil_gas.why: WTI up only 3% in 5 days on the known Iran story and no dated XOM catalyst, so it is priced in.

gold_miners.why: NEM +7.9% in a day and +30.6% in 20 days after the gold spike is priced in, with no dated catalyst.

chips.why: Sector is down 4% in 5 days, the NVDA date is unknown, and the export-loophole headline is not a clear reason.

pharma.why: LLY and the sector are at highs after a big one-day jump and no drug-specific cause appears.

copper_uranium.why: Copper flat in 5 and 20 days, and the FCX one-day jump looks like market beta with no catalyst.
